meta.name: ai-marketing-videos
meta.description: Create AI marketing videos for ads, promos, product launches, and brand content. Models: Veo, Seedance, Wan, FLUX for visuals, Kokoro for voiceover. Types: product demos, testimonials, explainers, social ads, brand videos. Use for: Facebook ads, YouTube ads, product launches, brand awareness. Triggers: marketing video, ad video, promo video, commercial, brand video, product video, explainer video, ad creative, video ad, facebook ad video, youtube ad, instagram ad, tiktok ad, promotional video, launch video

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成广告、促销和产品发布的营销视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在做广告或产品宣传,想直接用AI出片
copy.tagline_en: Generate marketing videos for ads, promos, and product launches
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make ads or product promos and want AI-generated video content.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能用 infsh 命令行生成营销视频:按时长和平台(6/15/30 秒、1:1/9:16)生成片段,配 Kokoro 配音,用 media-merger 合并,支持产品发布、品牌故事、讲解视频等。
howto.when: 当你提到“营销视频”“广告视频”“产品宣传”等触发词,或要求制作社交媒体广告、品牌内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 30 秒的产品广告视频,配上解说。
say.note: 按 30 秒广告工作流生成片段并合成配音。

say.text: 我要一条 15 秒的 Instagram 广告,正方形格式,适合静音观看。
say.note: 生成快节奏片段,并提示加字幕。

say.text: 帮我给这个 SaaS 写一个 60 秒讲解视频脚本。
say.note: 先写脚本,再给出画面和配音的命令。

howto.what_en: Using infsh CLI, Claude creates ads by duration/platform (6/15/30s, 1:1, 9:16), generates clips via Veo/others, voiceover via Kokoro, merges with media-merger; supports product launch, brand story, explainer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention marketing video, ad video, promo video, etc., or ask to create social media ads or brand content.

say_en.text: Make a 30-second product ad with voiceover.
say_en.note: Follows the 30s ad workflow and merges clips.

say_en.text: I need a 15-second Instagram square ad for muted viewing.
say_en.note: Generates fast-paced footage and suggests captions.

say_en.text: Write a 60-second explainer script for this SaaS product.
say_en.note: First writes script, then gives commands for visuals and voiceover.
